meta.title: Ripple's decision table for the guided safety harness
meta.purpose: Code decides, the model only reads (the owner, 2026-10-16: 「995、药、其他询问都应该有工程化的引导的 harness，而不是直接匹配一下就开始回答」; the research report D:/ripple-c2/audit/safety-harness-1016/ and its priority table). Each row says, for a set of facts about one message in its conversation (the risk screen's frame, the rules' floor and his answers to the scripted follow-up questions), which medical level or self-harm ladder step applies, which fixed lines (web/lib/safety/templates.ts TEMPLATES) are shown, which follow-up question is asked next (templates.ts FOLLOW_UPS), whether a question goes on his list and whether his family is told. Ripple never gives clinical advice of its own: every line here is a fixed sentence with its source, his doctor's recorded words or his label.
meta.how_rows_are_read: web/lib/safety/risk/table.ts. Two tracks, each read top to bottom, the first row whose `when` holds decides: the self-harm ladder (rows with `ladder`) and the medical levels (rows with `level`). `when` is a conjunction over the facts risk/pathways.ts derives (a value list means any of them). A fact a follow-up question can settle is `unknown` until it is said or answered; an answer of "Not sure", "I'd rather not say" or no answer is `unsure` and sits with the more dangerous values. A pathway asks at most three questions, never asks again in the same conversation once asked, and a fact it can no longer ask counts as `unsure`.
meta.ordering: Most dangerous first. Medical: every level-1 row of every pathway first (995 now: chest, stroke, breathing, a reading with a red flag, more of a medicine than the label, a side effect with a red flag); then the rows that ask (each showing its 995 line above the question) and the level-2 and level-3 rows, pathway by pathway in order of danger; then level 4. Ladder: danger, then thoughts, then the answer "No" to the confirm question, then possible. The higher of the two decides what is shown first; 995 and the helplines always come before a follow-up question; the rules' crisis routes (classify.ts) are the floor and are never lowered.

levels.1: call 995 now (or the nearest A&E); his family is told
levels.2: today: his pharmacist or doctor today, with the signs that mean 995 instead
levels.3: kept for his doctor, with the signs that mean 995
levels.4: an ordinary answer from his sources

ladder.possible: something may point to self-harm: the fixed safety line and the helplines first, then the confirm question
ladder.thoughts: thoughts of dying or self-harm, no immediate danger: the helplines, his family told, Ripple keeps inviting him to talk, the danger question
ladder.danger: immediate danger (thoughts, a plan, the means and within a day, or he says so): 995 first, the helplines, his family told

meta.review: Every row is "pending_clinician" until a pharmacist or doctor has read and signed it; the levels chosen where the task left a choice are on the careful side and say so in their note. Re-read the rows when a referral row or a template changes, and once a year against the sources.

sources_named.B1-xx, B2-xx, B3-xx, B4-xx: web/kb/referrals.json rows (each with its Singapore source)

rows.note: Someone else's self-harm signal he reports (round 2, 10-16: 'My father told me he has been hiding his sleeping pills instead of taking them'): the answer for them, as the rules' self-harm answer about someone else gives it (if they might hurt themselves or are in danger now, 995; SOS and mindline for them and for him). His own ladder stays at none: no watch state for him, and his family is not told (he is the one telling).
Someone else's crisis he reports: the rules' answer for them stands (self_harm_995_other and the helplines); the ladder never asks him about himself for it.
He says he is thinking of doing it soon or has something ready; "I'd rather not say" or no answer counts as yes (the contract: the more dangerous side).

Immediate danger: a wish to die (or words that may be one) with a plan and a time within a day ('I'm going to end it tonight, I've made up my mind'). Round 2, 10-16: the means are no longer required here (a plan for tonight said in words is enough to call 995; an older person rarely says what he would use). A passive wish needs the means too (self-harm-danger-plan-means): 'if I died in my sleep tonight it would be fine' is a wish with a time, not a plan.
Crisis Text Line's immediate risk: thoughts (a passive wish too), a specific plan, the means at hand and within 24 hours (the research report).
His yes (or 'rather not say') to the confirm question, with a plan and a time within a day: as self-harm-danger-plan.

An explicit wish to die or kill himself with tonight or today beside it ('I want to end my life tonight', 「今晚就要了结自己」): immediate danger without a plan said (round 2, 10-16; the coordinator's 'tonight/today with intent').

He says yes to the confirm question, or would rather not say (counted as yes: the owner's task of 10-16). The helplines (SOS 1767, CareText 9151 1767, mindline 1771; Care Corner in Mandarin), his family told (owner 10-16: 「也通知女儿」), the invitation to keep talking, then the danger question.

He answers No to the confirm question. The watch state (risk/watch.ts) reads this row id as his answer and turns off for low mood alone; a question about how much medicine is too much still triggers the ladder.

The rules' self-harm route (classify.ts) is the floor: its answer goes out as it did before (995 if in danger, SOS, mindline), and the ladder adds the invitation to keep talking and the danger question.
He says he wants to die or to end it (the screen's evidence checked: risk/evidence.ts).
Tablets taken on purpose, or he would rather not say whether: the ladder's thoughts beside the overdose's 995 (round 2, 10-16).

How much medicine would be too much, the most in one go, with the watch state on (low mood earlier, risk/watch.ts): up the ladder, never to the doctor's question list, never an amount or a label line (Crisis Text Line: a specific medicine is the most dangerous word they saw).

Saving up tablets ("there are enough now") with the watch state on. Pharmacists name stopping or hoarding medicines as a warning sign (the research report). Only a clear "yes": the rules' frame calls means "unclear" beside any other self-harm signal.

A question about a lethal amount is itself a red flag, whatever came before (RAND, Stanford, Google MUM: the lethality question dressed as looking something up). The confirm question, the safety line and the helplines; no amount and no label line in the answer.
Saving up tablets or having them ready, said: the confirm question; no amount and no label line.

A passive wish to die (seeing his late wife again soon, the children better off without him): older people say it this way more than "I want to die" (Raue et al. 2014). Asked directly, never answered as a note.

Tablets counted or kept that may be saving up ("I counted my pills", even for a refill: the rules' frame cannot tell them apart): the confirm question is cheap. After the passive row: beside any other self-harm signal the rules' frame calls means "unclear" by default.
Any question about how many tablets, with the watch state on: the confirm question first; no amount and no label line.

No model (offline, the spend cap, no AI consent, a timeout): the rules cannot read a passive or indirect wish to die (offline 2/10 in the 10-16 probe), so low mood is asked about directly, with the helplines visible (the research report's P0; AIHGle 2.0 section 6.7.1).
No model, and a question about the most, too many or all at once: asked directly. An ordinary dose question (one more tablet, two tablets, half a tablet) is not this row.

Self-harm cue words in a statement and nothing else (no SELF_HARM rule, no self-harm field in the frame, no crisis screen that read his words: pipeline.ts applyRulesOnlyCue). Round 2, 10-16: a cue word alone is a reason to ask, never 'thoughts' and never his family told ('die liao' in the heat, 熱到死).

The self-harm question his last answer asked went unanswered: he wrote about something else (round 2, 10-16: sc-sh-ignored-en dropped to none). An unanswered question is the careful side: the helplines stay on his screen and the same question is asked again while asks are left (three today); after that it counts as 'not sure' (the rows above: thoughts for the confirm question, danger for the danger question).
As self-harm-question-ignored, for the danger question (he had said he has these thoughts, or the rules did).

Chest pain or pressure still there (or not said to be gone) for 5 minutes or more, coming and going, or for a time he cannot say: 995 now (Singapore Heart Foundation: pain that goes on or keeps coming back; STCC's "and still present now"). The 10-10 audit: "an elephant on my chest for 10 minutes" was answered "noted for your doctor", Babylon's failure.
Chest pain now with a cold sweat, breathlessness, pain spreading to the arm, jaw or back, or very bad (B1-01's own list).

A stroke sign happening now or not said to be over: 995 with no question first (time-critical; HealthHub and SCDF: one F.A.S.T. sign is enough). The 10-16 probe: a drooping face got "noted for your doctor" before "call 995 now".

A stroke sign that has passed (a TIA) is 995 now: B1-03 and the NNI/SNSA BE FAST advice say call 995 even if the signs went away (round 2, 10-16; it was level 3, kept for his doctor). The fixed line says so and stands first; the sign is still kept for his doctor with its date and time after it. Chest pain that passed keeps the owner's 10-14 order (chest-gone, level 3).
Lips or face turning blue or grey (SCDF; B1-02).
Short of breath now even while resting (SCDF names breathlessness among its 995 examples).

Collapsed, cannot be woken, not responding, fainting or a fit, now or not said to be over (B1-04, B1-06, B1-09). The rules send these to 995 already; this row raises a phrasing only the risk screen understood (the old crisis screen's job).
Swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat, a tight throat (B1-05).
Vomiting or coughing up blood, black stools, bleeding that will not stop (B1-07).
A sudden, very severe headache (B1-03 lists it among the stroke signs).

A reading above his doctor's own line together with the worst headache, blurred vision, chest pain, breathlessness, weakness on one side or confusion: the 995 line first and without a condition, then his doctor's line (MOH, B1-10). The 10-16 probe: 210/125 with the worst headache got "If your reading is above 180 ..." first.

A child took the tablets, or he cannot say who: 995 now (webPOISONCONTROL refers children under six months and anyone it cannot screen; B1-12). Someone else's crisis: his family is not told (lib/care/told.ts).
Another adult took more than the label says: get them medical help straight away (as the rules decided before, fix round 3).

More than the label taken on purpose, or he would rather not say (round 2, 10-16: the pathway's last question, extra_purpose): 995 now (B1-12), and the self-harm ladder's thoughts beside it (self-harm-extra-on-purpose).
A sign now (very dizzy or faint, a very slow heartbeat, chest pain, vomiting, unusually sleepy): webPOISONCONTROL sends anyone with a symptom straight on (B1-12).
Two or more extra, or an amount he cannot say (NHS Pathways was criticised by two coroners for ignoring the drug, the amount and the time).
More than one of his medicines, or he cannot say which (webPOISONCONTROL refers more than one substance).
With the side effect: swelling of the face, lips or throat, chest pain, breathlessness, fainting or weakness on one side (B1-05, B1-01, B1-03).

rows.source: classify.ts EMERGENCY rules (the B1 row of each sign; owner 10-14: only chest pain, a stroke sign and a reading are kept for his doctor)
rows.note: The floor (round 2, 10-16): a crisis rule fired on his words and its answer is the fixed 'call 995 now' (breathing, collapse, confusion, a swelling face or throat, bleeding, a high reading with a symptom, someone else's emergency, chest pain or a stroke sign with words that say it is bad now, an overdose). That is level 1 whatever the frame holds, so the record says what his screen shows; the rows above it name the sign when the frame does. A sign only cue words saw is not this row: it goes to its pathway's question.

He fainted or passed out and has come round ('I fainted this morning, feel okay now'): checked by a doctor today to find out why, with the 995 signs (round 2, 10-16; B2-07 says soon, today is the careful side). Someone still unconscious, or not said to have come round, is collapse-now (995).
Chest pain, not said whether it is still there: the owner's 10-14 answer (kept for his doctor, his doctor's line, 995 if it is bad or does not go away) and the first question.
"No, it's gone" and nothing else with it: the owner's 10-14 conditional wording (his words kept for his doctor; 995 if it comes back or gets worse).
Still there for under 5 minutes, nothing with it: kept for his doctor with "call 995 if it is bad or does not go away". Level 3 rather than 2 is a choice for a clinician to confirm.

rows.question: doctor
rows.note: Breathless only when moving, lips not blue: for his doctor, with 995 if it happens at rest. Level 3 rather than 2 is a choice for a clinician to confirm.
A reading above his doctor's line and no sign said: his doctor's line first, kept, 995 if very unwell (the owner's 10-14 order), and the red-flag question.
Above his doctor's line and no sign with it: the existing answer.

rows.question: doctor
rows.note: The owner's 10-14 answer to one tablet too many (his doctor's words, his label, ask today, 995 if very unwell) and the question about a sign now.

Whether it was taken on purpose, asked last and only when his words do not say it was a mistake (by mistake, 不小心, forgot he had taken it): the contract's intent question, which webPOISONCONTROL asks too. Round 2, 10-16.

rows.question: doctor
rows.note: One extra of his own medicine, no sign now, not on purpose: the owner's 10-14 answer, not 995. Its line keeps "if you feel very unwell, call 995": the amlodipine leaflet says some effects of too much appear 24 to 48 hours later.

rows.question: pharmacist
rows.note: Tablets of a new colour, shape or marking that nobody explained: ISMP's first reason to suspect a dispensing error; check with the pharmacist before taking them (referrals.json B3-05). Never "stop taking it" as Ripple's own instruction.

rows.question: doctor
rows.note: Someone else told him to stop ("my son says I should stop the cholesterol pill"): his doctor's "don't change the dose" line and his label (the dose-change answer), a question for his doctor, and whether he has stopped already.

rows.question: doctor
rows.note: A blood pressure medicine (or one nobody can name) stopped for days: ask his doctor today, 995 if very unwell. Decided on the careful side while no clinician has signed it; stopped today is level 3.

Asked about ("can I stop?"), not stopped yet, or stopped today: the existing dose-change answer (his doctor's "don't change the dose" line, his label, "questions about changing your medicine are for your doctor" and the question on his list), nothing added.

rows.question: doctor
rows.note: A possible side effect (ankles swollen since the new pill): his doctor's words and the leaflet's side-effect line where his sources have them, the question for his doctor, the safety-net line, and the red-flag question.
A missed dose and more than one medicine it could be: which one, then that leaflet's own missed-dose line. Never Ripple's own instruction.
The leaflet's own missed-dose line for that medicine (the existing answer).

The question his last answer asked about this sign went unanswered: he wrote about something else (round 2, 10-16: sc-chest-ignored-en lost the 995 line). No answer is the careful side: the pathway's 995 signs stay on his next answer, kept for his doctor, with no question (a new message about the sign asks again).

The question his last answer asked about this sign went unanswered: he wrote about something else (round 2, 10-16: sc-chest-ignored-en lost the 995 line). No answer is the careful side: the pathway's 995 signs stay on his next answer, kept for his doctor, with no question (a new message about the sign asks again).

The question his last answer asked about this sign went unanswered: he wrote about something else (round 2, 10-16: sc-chest-ignored-en lost the 995 line). No answer is the careful side: the pathway's 995 signs stay on his next answer, kept for his doctor, with no question (a new message about the sign asks again).

The question his last answer asked about this sign went unanswered: he wrote about something else (round 2, 10-16: sc-chest-ignored-en lost the 995 line). No answer is the careful side: the pathway's 995 signs stay on his next answer, kept for his doctor, with no question (a new message about the sign asks again).
As chest-question-ignored, for one tablet too many: 'ask today', with the 995 signs in the same line.
Nothing above holds: the ordinary answer from his sources.
